answers.topic: Housing Apply partially succeeds then blocks retries
answers.answer: Production aggregate readback confirms all 113 unique saved desired assignments and the original plan hash remain intact. Apply recorded one verified room assignment, stopped at the next assignment, and recorded no charge reconciliation. The failed target has no active assignment in either read source. Nonprod isolated assignment tests showed missing rent setup can reject assignments, but production commuter setup exists with zero per-person rates, so that is not established as this failure’s cause. CF-031 now provides a read-only recovery review and explicitly confirmed resume for additive commuter runs, skipping verified completed assignments while preserving the 113-entry plan and prior history. It retains safe error categories and blocks Refresh of a partial run. CF-031 is committed and deployed in both environments; this does not establish the original rejection cause.
answers.nextStep: Jeff should use Review recovery first. Confirm the preserved 113-entry plan and current assignments/billing before any explicit Resume. Resume affects the batch, not only his account; original vendor rejection is not yet confirmed fixed.
